title: Greenstar Sitao: Characteristics
metaDescription: Greenstar sitao is a pole sitao variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Greenstar sitao is a pole sitao variety, also sold or known as Greenstar pole sitao. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Greenstar sitao is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Greenstar pole sitao, this is the same sitao. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sitao variety finder](/crop-varieties/sitao), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sitao fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Where and when to plant Greenstar sitao

Pole sitao climbs a trellis and bears for weeks, while bush sitao needs no trellis and comes in at once. Pick long, dark green pods that snap cleanly, and a variety rated against the bean fly and rust if you can. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Greenstar pole sitao the same as Greenstar?
items.a: Yes. Greenstar pole sitao is another name for Greenstar. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Greenstar?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
